notes.title: Come One, Come All: HistoryMaker VR is Now Free on Steam!
notes.notes:
During this challenging time, Schell Games is interested in finding ways to support teachers and families in their educational pursuits. So, [i][url=https://historymakervr.schellgames.com/]HistoryMaker VR[/url][/i] is now available for free on Steam for all to use! 

With the majority of schools participating in distance learning this year, [i]HistoryMaker VR[/i] provides teachers, parents, and guardians an entertaining and engaging way to help students learn history from the safety of their own homes. This immersive content creation tool allows learners to display their knowledge of history, civics, and social studies while offering educators and parents a new way to improve student engagement, increase lesson retention, and introduce an exciting alternative to textbooks and Zoom lectures.

Using an Oculus Rift/Rift S headset and PC, learners and/or educators can upload a script, set the stage, and record themselves giving a speech as one of eight diverse characters in U.S. history. Once complete, speeches can be exported as a video, edited, and shared with others without the need for a VR headset!

For more information, classroom guides, and recommended activities, [url=https://historymakervr.schellgames.com/]visit the website here[/url].

notes.title: Hear Ye, Hear Ye: HistoryMaker VR is Available Now!
notes.notes:
Time to make history! As of today, HistoryMaker VR is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1278000/HistoryMaker_VR/]now available on Steam[/url]!

Immerse yourself in this content creation tool and become one of eight diverse figures of U.S. history, including Benjamin Franklin, Harriet Tubman, and Sonia Sotomayor. Upload your speech, design your stage with props and set pieces, and record your historical performance! Then, export your performance to share it with your classmates or the world!

Are you an educator? HistoryMaker VR is the perfect complement for social studies, history, and civics classes in both middle and high school. This standards-aligned experience can be seamlessly integrated into classrooms. We even have lesson plans, sample activities, and implementation instructions available for download. For more infor­ma­tion on how to bring Histo­ry­Maker VR to the classroom, [url=https://historymakervr.schellgames.com/]visit the website here[/url].
